cases.name: Grave Pact
cases.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control dies, each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: Source-only control if absent from the authored catalog. Your creature death triggers sacrifice by each other player.

cases.name: Pyretic Prankster // Glistening Goremonger
cases.oracle_text:
{3}{B/P}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery. ({B/P} can be paid with either {B} or 2 life.)
When this creature dies, each opponent sacrifices an artifact or creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: The back face dying triggers each opponent to sacrifice an artifact or creature. The front face has no death-response operation.

cases.name: The Serpent Society
cases.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Ward—Get five poison counters. (A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.)
Whenever another creature you control with deathtouch dies, each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: Another creature you control must have deathtouch when it dies. Each opponent chooses a nontoken creature to sacrifice.

cases.name: Zulaport Cutthroat
cases.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cases.expectation: A creature you control dying produces two separate operations on the same action: each opponent loses one life and the controller gains one.

cases.name: Deathcurse Ogre
cases.oracle_text: When this creature dies, each player loses 3 life.
cases.expectation: Self death makes each player lose three life, including the controller.

cases.name: Blood Artist
cases.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cases.expectation: Creature death triggers life loss for a chosen player and gain for the controller.

cases.name: Fleshbag Marauder
cases.oracle_text: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: Self entry makes each player sacrifice a creature. Resulting deaths are separate events.

cases.name: Midnight Reaper
cases.oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, this creature deals 1 damage to you and you draw a card.
cases.expectation: A nontoken creature you control dying triggers player damage from this source and a draw. Damage is distinct from direct life loss.

cases.name: Gravelighter
cases.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, draw a card if a creature died this turn. Otherwise, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: Self entry triggers. Death history is checked at resolution and selects draw or sacrifice. The sacrifice is on the false branch.

cases.name: Grim Haruspex
cases.oracle_text:
Morph {B} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, draw a card.
cases.expectation: Other own nontoken death triggers a draw.

cases.name: Pitiless Plunderer
cases.oracle_text: Whenever another creature you control dies, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
cases.expectation: Other own creature death creates Treasure, not an immediate mana operation.

cases.name: Viscera Seer
cases.oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
cases.expectation: Sacrifice pays a cost. Scry is not a triggered response.

cases.name: Lord Xander, the Collector
cases.oracle_text:
When Lord Xander enters, target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded down.
Whenever Lord Xander attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded down.
When Lord Xander dies, target opponent sacrifices half the nonland permanents they control of their choice, rounded down.
cases.expectation: Self death triggers targeted opponent sacrifice of half their nonland permanents, rounded down. Quantity remains unresolved here.

cases.name: Personal Incarnation
cases.oracle_text:
{0}: The next 1 damage that would be dealt to this creature this turn is dealt to its owner instead. Only this creature's owner may activate this ability.
When this creature dies, its owner loses half their life, rounded up.
cases.expectation: Self death targets the owner for variable direct life loss. Owner and controller may differ.

syntheticControls: A death trigger tells each opponent to sacrifice one creature. A separate activation pays a sacrifice cost.
Creature entry and creature death can lead to the same direct life instruction.
An optional direct life loss for the controller can be supported. Zero is inert and unresolved dynamic amounts remain uncertain.
An entry-triggered branch may sacrifice a creature but its trigger remains entry. Unsupported trigger scope and branch guards remain uncertain.
